## v0.4.4-1 Release Notes

### ✨ Feature

- Added BYOK support with encrypted provider keys, provider import links, administrator access policies, and per-model API protocol selection.
- Added stateful interactive UI blocks with formulas, sliders, explorable diagrams, follow-up actions, and conversation-persisted state.
- Added vector index task management with status review and retries for failed, stale, stalled, or unprocessed files.
- Added persistent error logs and searchable error IDs, with upstream diagnostics for administrators and copyable IDs for users.

### ⚡ Optimization

- Refined the mobile composer so menus stay on screen and image/video parameters are available directly from the composer.
- Improved HTML, Mermaid, and interactive widget rendering, including clearer fallback behavior.
- Added native desktop menus and shortcuts for common app and tab actions.

### 🐛 Fixed

- Fixed private messaging connections disconnecting one another when the same account was open in multiple tabs or devices.
- Fixed private messaging status and event requests repeatedly retrying expired access tokens instead of refreshing them after a 401 response.
- Fixed the desktop tab strip height on Linux.
- Fixed outbound requests ignoring `HTTP_PROXY` and `HTTPS_PROXY` when SSRF protection was enabled.
- Prevented API key hints from appearing in audit records and improved handling of imported provider URLs.

---

## v0.4.4-1 中文版本

### ✨ Feature

- 新增 BYOK 支持，包括加密存储供应商密钥、供应商导入链接、管理员访问策略，以及按模型选择 API 协议。
- 新增有状态交互式 UI 块，支持公式、滑块、可探索图表、追问操作，以及随会话持久保存的交互状态。
- 新增向量索引任务管理，可查看任务状态，并针对失败、过期、停滞或尚未处理的文件重试。
- 新增持久化错误日志与可搜索的错误 ID；管理员可查看上游诊断详情，用户可直接复制错误 ID 反馈问题。

### ⚡ Optimization

- 优化移动端输入区，确保菜单保持在屏幕内，并可直接配置图片与视频参数。
- 改进 HTML、Mermaid 和交互式组件的渲染及内容无法渲染时的回退展示。
- 为桌面端新增原生菜单和常用应用、标签页操作快捷键。

### 🐛 Fixed

- 修复同一账号在多个标签页或设备打开私聊时，实时连接互相踢下线的问题。
- 修复私聊状态和事件请求遇到 401 后反复使用过期令牌重试、无法自动刷新认证的问题。
- 修复 Linux 桌面端标签栏高度不稳定的问题。
- 修复启用 SSRF 防护后，出站请求不遵循 `HTTP_PROXY` 和 `HTTPS_PROXY` 的问题。
- 修复审计记录暴露 API 密钥提示信息的问题，并改进供应商导入链接的处理。

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/amaoworks/DEEIX-Chat/compare/v0.4.3-1...v0.4.4-1
